* Clear, concise communication of technical ideas — in design documents, code reviews, and cross\\-functional discussions.

description:
**About the Role** 




 Auric AI Labs is developing the world's most advanced AI\\-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications. Our system processes satellite (EO, IR, SAR, hyperspectral) and drone imagery to detect, classify, and track high\\-value enemy assets like tanks, radars, missile launchers, aircraft, and warships.
 



 We are not just building an AI model—we are designing the future of defense intelligence, enabling real\\-time situational awareness and strategic military decision\\-making.
 



 If you’re an exceptional AI/Computer Vision Researcher who thrives on solving hard problems with first\\-principles thinking, we want you on our team.
 



**What You’ll Do** 




**Computer Vision Model Development** 



* Design, train, and deploy advanced computer vision models to detect and classify a wide range of military assets, including trucks, tanks, radars, aircraft, ships, and submarines.
* Optimize models for high accuracy and efficiency to ensure reliable real\\-time performance in mission\\-critical operations.



**Data Processing \\& Pipeline Development** 



* Build scalable data pipelines to process large volumes of imagery from satellite, drone, and ground\\-based sources.
* Handle preprocessing tasks such as data cleaning, annotation, and augmentation to prepare datasets for model training.
* Develop systems for integrating and managing multi\\-modal imagery (optical, thermal, radar) to strengthen model robustness.



**Geospatial Analysis \\& Targeting** 



* Implement intelligent target prioritization workflows that adapt dynamically to operator inputs.
* Develop advanced localization techniques to determine and visualize the position of identified targets accurately.



**Skills \\& Qualifications** 



* Demonstrated excellence through research, internships, or personal projects in computer vision.
* Strong foundation in first\\-principles problem solving to tackle complex technical challenges.
* Proficiency in Python with hands\\-on experience in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and OpenCV.
* Expertise in image processing, object detection, segmentation, and classification.



**Why Join Us?** 



* Be part of building a groundbreaking, high\\-impact defense technology platform.
* Collaborate with a team of innovative professionals dedicated to excellence.
* Competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your expertise.
* Shape the future of AI\\-driven defense solutions while making a direct contribution to national security.

title: Technical Product Manager 'Vibe Coder'

description:
The Impact You'll Make:
 



 As a Technical Product Manager (Prototyping) — or as we call it, a "Vibe Coder" — you'll be the orchestrator, commanding AI agents to build functional prototypes that solve real\\-world friction. You will personally build rapid prototypes that others will test and iterate on immediately, solving friction. Your prototypes will go from concept to user feedback in hours or days, not weeks and months—you'll see ideas tested, refined, and iterated on in real time.
 



  





 This is a "Hands\\-on\\-Keys" role. You're expected to build functional prototypes yourself—but you're not writing every line of code from scratch. You command AI agents to handle the
 



 heavy lift of the software, while you focus on the product logic, the user interface, and the overall "vibe" of the solution.
 



  





 How You'll Do It:
 



 • Own the end\\-to\\-end prototyping lifecycle. You own this autonomously—from identifying friction to shipping a working prototype—but you'll collaborate closely with others on discovery and feedback loops. You're the maker in charge, not a ticket\\-taker
 



 • identify real\\-world friction points, then translate verbal needs into structured logic and functional designs.
 



 • Personally develop functional prototypes using AI\\-native development environments, commanding LLMs and agentic workflows to generate the heavy lift of the code
 



 • Prioritize speed and flexibility to create proof\\-of\\-concept models that can be tested, refined, and iterated on instantly based on user feedback
 



 • Document the logic, prompt architecture (the structured prompts and agent workflows that drive the AI), and design decisions to provide a clear technical "north star" for traditional engineering teams to eventually harden into production
 



 • Conduct testing and validation to ensure prototypes meet functional requirements and solve the original user "pain" before hand\\-off
 



  





 Qualifications:
 



 You're the Missing Piece If You Have This Profile
 



 Must\\-Haves:
 



 • You're a Maker with an AI\\-First Mindset: You're hungry and eager to experiment. You aren't tied to "legacy" ways of working and prefer finding the shortest path to a working demo.
 



 You're excited to experiment with new tooling, accept ambiguity as you build, and prioritize speed to working demos over perfectly structured code
 



 • You understand the fundamentals of logic and code: You have experience with Python, JavaScript, or equivalent—enough to know when the AI is right and when it's hallucinating.
 



 You can "read" code fluently even if you "write" it via AI. (Depth in one language is sufficient; we don't require fluency in both.)
 



 • You're a Product\\-First Thinker: You care more about solving the user's problem and reducing their admin time than about the specific syntax of the code.
 



 You've gathered requirements directly from end\\-users and translated their needs into technical designs or prototypes
 



 • You're an All\\-Star Communicator: You can translate a vague request into a highly specific technical "vibe" that the AI can build. You're comfortable interfacing with non\\-technical stakeholders and turning business problems into technical requirements
 



  





 Nice\\-to\\-Haves:
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a technical field (or equivalent hands\\-on building experience—self\\-taught engineers, bootcamp grads, and career\\-switchers with proven building experience are welcome)
 



 • You've built functional prototypes or proof\\-of\\-concepts that went from concept to user feedback within hours to days
